Watching web television
Using storage space on the internet to save documents pictures music video or other files (Google Drive Dropbox iCloud etc.)

Using services related to travel or travel related accommodation
Reading or downloading newspapers magazines or electronic books in a digital format
Using software that runs over the internet for editing text documents spreadsheets or presentations
Looking for a job or sending/submitting a job application (includes searching specific websites for a job

Participating in professional networks (Linkedin Jobstreet Indeed etc.)
